why: The federal Title V rule applies because the computed NOx potential to emit of 1,067 tpy meets the 100 tpy major-source threshold per 40 CFR 70.2. The Texas SB 6 rule applies because the 300 MW load exceeds the 75 MW threshold stated in the bill text, with a computed margin of 225 MW. Both rules are graded major, indicating they impose significant permitting and interconnection requirements but do not block the project. No other applicable rules were found for this site, so the verdict is conditional.
